meta.title: Africa Startup Festival Event App Guide
meta.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

sections.question: What is the Africa Startup Festival app?
sections.answerSummary: All-in-one digital companion for the event. Manage tickets, connect with attendees and speakers, schedule meetings, discover sessions, receive real-time notifications.

body.text: The Africa Startup Festival app is your all-in-one digital companion for the event. It allows you to:
It is designed to make networking and coordination seamless before and during the event.

body.text: There is no password required.
To log in:

items: Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your email.

body.text: Once verified, you will either:

sections.question: What happens the first time I log in?
sections.answerSummary: First-time users must review ticket allocation, assign any available quota tickets, complete required profile details. After setup, future logins go straight to the app.

sections.question: What information is required on my profile?
sections.answerSummary: Required: Full Name, Job Title, Company/Organisation, LinkedIn Profile. Optional: Profile Photo, Bio, Country, Interests.

body.text: Required:

items: LinkedIn Profile (valid LinkedIn URL or username)

body.text: Optional:
Accurate profiles improve your visibility and networking opportunities.

sections.question: How do I view my tickets?
sections.answerSummary: Go to Menu → My Ticket(s) or Scan → My Ticket. You see personal ticket, assigned tickets, available unassigned tickets.

body.text: Go to:

Menu → My Ticket(s)
or

sections.question: How do I assign a ticket from my quota?
sections.answerSummary: Open Menu → My Ticket(s), select available ticket, enter recipient details, confirm. Recipient must accept. Revoking only possible before acceptance.

body.text: If you have multiple tickets under your allocation:

items: Enter recipient name, email, and phone number

body.text: The recipient must accept the allocation before the ticket becomes active.

items: Revoking an assigned ticket is only possible before the recipient accepts the invitation.
You can't revoke or edit an already assigned ticket that has been accepted. You can only revoke if the recipient hasn't accepted yet.

sections.question: How do I transfer my personal ticket?
sections.answerSummary: Only after all quota tickets are assigned. Go to Menu → My Ticket(s), select personal ticket, Transfer Ticket, enter recipient, confirm. Transfers are irreversible.

body.text: You can only transfer your personal ticket after all quota tickets have been assigned.

If the app says:
"You have X available ticket(s) to assign"
You must assign those first.
To transfer:

items: Once transferred, you permanently lose access to the event.

body.text: The recipient must accept the allocation before activation.

sections.question: How does networking work?
sections.answerSummary: Go to Attendees tab. All Attendees shows full list, Recommended shows curated suggestions. Connect or request meetings from either.

body.text:
Where do I find attendees?
Go to the Attendees tab.
You will see two sections:

items: All Attendees: Full list of participants
Recommended: Curated suggestions based on your profile

body.text: You can connect or request meetings from either section.

sections.question: How do connections work?
sections.answerSummary: Send connection request, other person accepts, they appear in Connections tab. From Connections you can request meetings. Accept or decline requests, remove connections.

items: They appear in your Connections tab.

body.text: From Connections, you can request meetings.
You can also:

sections.question: How do meetings work?
sections.answerSummary: Under Meetings → Requests: Inbound = requests sent to you (accept/reject). Outbound = requests you sent (pending). When accepted, moves to Scheduled for both.

body.text: What is the difference between Inbound and Outbound?
Under Meetings → Requests:

items: Inbound: Requests sent to you. You must Accept or Reject.
Outbound: Requests you sent to others. They remain pending until accepted or rejected.

body.text: When accepted, the meeting moves to the Scheduled tab for both users.

sections.question: Do meeting requests expire?
sections.answerSummary: Yes. Pending requests show Expires in 24 hours. Respond before expiry. If expired, may no longer be available.

body.text: Yes.

Pending requests show:
"Expires in 24 hours"
You must respond before it expires.
The exact timeframe depends on event settings, but the remaining time is always displayed in the app.
If a request expires, it may no longer be available to accept.

sections.question: How do I request a meeting?
sections.answerSummary: Request from Attendees, Connections, or scanned profile. Provide meeting title/reason, date and time, virtual link if applicable. Appears under Meetings → Requests → Outbound.

body.text: You can request meetings from:
Provide:

The request will appear under:
Meetings → Requests → Outbound
Once accepted, it moves to Scheduled for both users.

sections.question: Why can't I request meetings?
sections.answerSummary: Some ticket types (e.g. Limited Pass / Expo passes) do not include meeting privileges. Upgrade your ticket from My Ticket to unlock meetings and other benefits.

body.text: Some ticket types (e.g., Limited Pass or Expo passes) do not include meeting privileges.
If restricted, you will see an alert when you try to book a meeting.
To unlock meetings and other benefits, go to Menu → My Ticket(s) or Scan → My Ticket and tap Upgrade Ticket on your personal pass.

sections.question: How does QR code scanning work?
sections.answerSummary: Use Scan feature to scan attendee ticket. After scanning you can view profile, connect, request meeting.

body.text: Use the Scan feature to scan an attendee's ticket.

sections.question: How do I browse event sessions?
sections.answerSummary: Go to Schedule tab. Browse sessions by day. Session feedback links appear on session cards when available.

body.text: Go to the Schedule tab.
You can browse sessions by day.
When available, session cards include a Leave Feedback link so you can share feedback on individual sessions.

sections.question: What notifications will I receive?
sections.answerSummary: Connection requests and approvals, meeting requests and responses, ticket allocations and transfers, startup join updates. Tap notification to go to relevant section.

body.text: You will receive notifications for:
Tap a notification to go directly to the relevant section.

sections.question: Why can't I access the main app?
sections.answerSummary: You may not have completed required profile fields. Restart app and complete all mandatory details.

body.text: You may not have completed required profile fields.
Restart the app and then you will be led to complete your profile, fill all mandatory details, and save.

sections.question: Why can't I transfer my ticket?
sections.answerSummary: You likely still have available quota tickets. Assign all available tickets first, then transfer personal ticket.

body.text: You likely still have available quota tickets.
Assign all available tickets first, then return to transfer your personal ticket.

sections.question: Why didn't the recipient receive the ticket?
sections.answerSummary: Recipient must accept ticket allocation notification before activation. Ask them to check app notifications and registered email.

body.text: The recipient must accept the ticket allocation notification before activation.
Ask them to check:

sections.question: I can't find my meeting request. Where is it?
sections.answerSummary: Check Meetings → Requests → Outbound if you sent it. Check Inbound if it was sent to you.

body.text:
Check:
Meetings → Requests → Outbound

If it was sent to you, check:
Meetings → Requests → Inbound

sections.question: What are the most important things to remember?
sections.answerSummary: Personal ticket transfers irreversible. Assigned tickets must be accepted. Revoking only before acceptance. Meeting access depends on ticket type. Meeting requests expire. Keep profile accurate.

items: Assigned tickets must be accepted before activation.
Revoking an assigned ticket is only possible before the recipient accepts the invitation.
Meeting access depends on ticket type.
Meeting requests expire after 24 hours if not responded to.
Keep your profile accurate for better networking results.

sections.question: How do I re-assign an already accepted ticket?
sections.answerSummary: You cannot re-assign a ticket after the recipient has accepted it. Only the current holder can transfer it to someone else.

body.text: When a ticket has already been assigned to a recipient and they've accepted it, you will not be able to reassign it to somebody else yourself.
Only the recipient who currently has the ticket can transfer it to a new recipient.

items: If you want it to go to someone else after it's been accepted, ask the current holder to transfer it for you.

sections.question: How do I upgrade my ticket?
sections.answerSummary: Open My Ticket, tap Upgrade Ticket, choose a higher tier, pay via Korapay (KES) or Stripe (USD). Upgrade path: Limited Pass → Explorer → Startup → Operator → Gold Investor.

body.text: Ticket upgrades are available for eligible attendee passes.
To upgrade:

items: Go to Menu → My Ticket(s) or Scan → My Ticket
Select payment method (Korapay for KES or Stripe for USD)
Complete payment on the checkout page

body.text:
Upgrade path:
Limited Pass → Explorer → Startup → Operator → Gold Investor
Higher tiers unlock more networking features such as meeting access. Exhibitor, Partner, Media, and Speaker passes are not upgradeable through this flow.

sections.question: How does messaging work?
sections.answerSummary: Messages are available after an accepted connection or accepted meeting. Gold Investor pass holders can message anyone. Find conversations under Menu → Messages.

body.text: You can message other attendees when:

items: You have an accepted connection with them, or
You have an accepted meeting with them

body.text: Gold Investor pass holders can message any attendee without a prior connection.
To view conversations, go to Menu → Messages.
If messaging is unavailable, connect with the person first or wait until a meeting request is accepted.

sections.question: How do startup profiles and join requests work?
sections.answerSummary: Startup ticket holders can link to a startup company. Submit a join request from your profile; admins approve or deny. Approved members show a startup badge on their profile.

body.text: If you hold a Startup pass or belong to a startup company, you can link your profile to that startup.
To join a startup:

items: Wait for the startup admin to approve

body.text: Once approved, a startup badge appears on your profile across the app (Attendees, Connections, etc.).
Startup admins can review and approve or deny incoming join requests from their profile.

sections.question: Why does login say I don't have a ticket?
sections.answerSummary: Your email is not registered for a ticket to this event. Purchase a ticket on the festival website, then return to log in with the same email.

body.text: If you see "No ticket found" or "You do not have a ticket for this event" when requesting a login code, your email is not linked to a valid ticket for this festival.
To fix this:

items: Purchase a ticket on the Africa Startup Festival website
Use the same email address you used at checkout
Return to the app and request a new verification code

body.text: If you believe this is an error, contact support at info@africastartupfestival.com.

sections.question: How do I leave feedback or app suggestions?
sections.answerSummary: Session feedback from Schedule cards, meeting feedback from scheduled meeting detail, app suggestions from Menu → App Suggestions.

body.text: There are several ways to share feedback:

items: Session feedback: open a session on the Schedule tab and tap Leave Feedback
Meeting feedback: open a scheduled meeting and tap Leave Feedback
App suggestions: go to Menu → App Suggestions to share ideas for improving the app

body.text: For support issues, use Menu → Contact Us or email info@africastartupfestival.com.
